command: set -eu; CONTROL="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/litegraph/control"; echo '=== STATUS ==='; git -C "$CONTROL" status -sb; echo LOCAL_HEAD=$(git -C "$CONTROL" rev-parse HEAD); echo LOCAL_ORIGIN=$(git -C "$CONTROL" rev-parse origin/agent-control 2>/dev/null || true); echo REMOTE_HEAD=$(git -C "$CONTROL" ls-remote origin refs/heads/agent-control | awk '{print $1}'); echo '=== LOCAL CONTROL REQUEST ==='; if test -f "$CONTROL/.agent/daemon/control.json"; then cat "$CONTROL/.agent/daemon/control.json"; else echo '<missing>'; fi; echo '=== RECENT CONTROL HISTORY ==='; git -C "$CONTROL" log -n 12 --oneline -- .agent/daemon/control.json
